reviewer: the author (adversarial self-check; the independent review was stopped by the human's pause before it reported)
commit: the WIP draft 3a63fbf, re-read against the lead 2ef07b6 and I28's build head abb834b (PR #50)
verdict_note: Self-check, not an independent review: the human paused the session while the independent reviewer was fifteen minutes in, and the code-red process that followed runs no separate review agents. Every claim, number and test was re-checked against the code and the committed records. Five defects would have made a correct build fail its own contract (R1 against R7, R4's helper extraction, P7's markers, the storage default against I28's code, the fixed count 51 against I71's law); one prediction was out of date (P5's TI4 carve-out predates F40); one contract sentence misdescribed an API (check_entry's result). All are folded into the prereg commit.

findings.what: R1 failed any own commit touching a file under laws/, but S11 and R7 require remodel lines appended to laws/STATEMENT_DIFF.jsonl, so a correct build could not pass both.
findings.fix: R1 judges law files, REGISTRY.json, DERIVATION.json, gen/M3/laws/, LAWS.bend and the catalog; laws/STATEMENT_DIFF.jsonl may only gain lines, each of kind remodel (checked append-only).

findings.what: R4 searched holon/sorts/prelude3.py's Python source for Bend `def w_add(` blocks; w_add, w_add_ok and w_sub are generated by Python functions (_w_add, _w_sub) at import, so the regex finds nothing and the test errors on every build.
findings.fix: R4 executes prelude3.py as it stood at the prereg (as F32's test does), takes each helper's block from its PRELUDE, and requires the same block in every structural model and section file.

findings.where: rule S1, S4; test_s1_s4; holon/versions/model.py at I28's head (compile_unit, Layer)
findings.what: I28's versioned generator calls model3.Model3 and model3.build_text without a mode, writes M3.MODEL3_VERSION into its module headers and embeds prelude3.PRELUDE in its layer, whose conversions (lKW_, cst_, stc_, vr0, vread) are written for the raw KW store. A structural default, a bumped MODEL3_VERSION or a changed PRELUDE would change I28's committed outputs and break its layer.
findings.fix: Raw stays the default of build_text and Model3, with PRELUDE and MODEL3_VERSION (holon-model-m3/0.2) unchanged; the structural store is PRELUDE_SK, its version MODEL3_SK_VERSION (holon-model-m3/0.3), and model3.generate (the typed model, its twin, sections, gates and intake) passes the structural mode.

findings.what: I28's committed V6 says the versioned model follows the adopted document's storage representation ("a later key may change the storage representation, and the versioned model follows it"). With the versioned machine kept raw (B3), that sentence stops holding after I68.
findings.fix: S4 says so in so many words, the report will say so, and Question H2 asks for the key that converts the versioned layer (vread's layout coordinates make SK reads direct). Converting brave-wright's in-flight layer inside I68 is not in scope.

findings.where: rules S11, S12; I68-R2, R5, R7; test_r2, test_r5, test_r7
findings.what: Every count was fixed at 51, but I71 (UNDO's cancel sub-form) may merge before I68's outcome run, adding a typed law over the UNDO section that I68 must remake and remodel too; R7 would then fail on a correct build, and R5 would miss that law's record.
findings.fix: S11 defines the typed laws as those bound to the typed model or its sections at the run (51 at the prereg, plus any another key adds); R7 expects one remodel line per such law, R5 judges every record by its artifacts' model, and R2 requires an added law to keep the status it had before I68 remade it. The counted predictions stay about the 51.

findings.what: P7's test looked for "out of fuel" and "timed out" in attempts only; the runners record a kernel stop as budget_exhausted ("bend2 time box (N s)", "BendTT time box", "BendTT out of fuel") and a timeout as "[timeout]", also under witnesses and non_vacuity, so a stop could pass unnoticed.
findings.fix: P7's test scans attempts, kernels, witnesses and non_vacuity for any budget_exhausted key and for "out of fuel", "[timeout]" or "time box" in a verdict, result, marker, error or detail.

findings.what: P5 carved out TI4 ("no explored state has _initialized >= 4, as for its rev twin"), copied from the Q21 design note, which predates F40. At the base, L_disch_rev_initializable_120_d9a34b48 is inhabited by a successful initialize4 one step from s0 (F40's Q36), which leaves _initialized == 4: TI4's blocking premise is reachable.
findings.fix: P5 predicts every flipped law inhabited, TI4 included; the test drops the carve-out; L3 is withdrawn. A stronger prediction, from the record at the base.

findings.what: S11 said check_entry returns {"ok", "problems"}; holon.statement_diff.check_entry returns {"ok", "reason", "implication"} for every kind and requires the old and new law IR.
findings.fix: S11 names the entry's "old" and "new" (the law's IR, identical) and check_entry's usual result.

findings.what: The draft did not say what I68 does to I30's term-size tests. I30-P7 is red at the base (:363's law_terms 1107 > 1000); its counter-law states its intermediate states as literal KW lists, which the measure counts entry by entry, so SK keys (longer literals) will grow it. I30-P8 (cone ratio 1.0145 <= 1.5) passes at the base (run, 8 s).
findings.fix: S13 and known_red_at_base say P7 stays red and grows; a new regression I68-R8 runs I30-P8's test as it stands.

findings.what: Base PENDING; the order predated the code-red process (one PR per iteration, C_K pushed first); the disclosure did not name the stopped review, the I28 code read or the base run; known_red_at_base still listed I25's commit test, fixed at 2ef07b6.

checked_fine: The 51 typed laws, their rules, subforms and statuses match results/M3 at the base; the 14 flips are all UNKNOWN there; DISCH is 13/7/15.

R5's record fields (traces, steps, storage_slots, disagreements, unexplained, by_action, panics, evaluator_sha256) and the key's r5 pins match results/M3/sorts/refinement.json; its evaluator_sha256 is the committed model's.
The instrument classifies the committed capture as the key pins (9 literal, 7 structural, 2 raw) with a clean keys check (TestPrereg passes).

Record formats the tests read: kernels [{name: bend2|bendtt, result: checked}], non_vacuity {status: inhabited, reachable: true}, replay {status: passed}, SORT/DISCH model_assumptions and UNDO/FACT ledger_assumptions, artifacts.model per rule.
holon.disch.gate.DischGate takes any object with m, root, gen and results; its G4 builds one disch_writer canary per PROVED blocking law with a named class.
F32's test reads prelude3.PRELUDE (exec of the module) and stays green while PRELUDE keeps its text.
No earlier test pins the raw store's text, h_get slot computations or the DISCH refusal messages (grep over tests/, tests_m2/, tests_m3/).

Whether H1's remodel channel should also cover a typed law added by another key before the run (S11 assumes yes: same model change, same criteria).
